claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 µM isoxsuprine is expected to inhibit CDK1 (reported IC50 2.9 µM), leading to cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis in proliferating cancer cells; beta-adrenergic agonism is unlikely to be the dominant cytotoxic driver.
